methods.notes: Advertises the Nordic UART service. The advertised-name convention was not captured from a cited source, so match on the NUS service plus a valid 5A A5 reply.

device.name: Ninebot / Segway E-Scooter (BLE)
device.notes:
Ninebot / Segway ES and MAX (G30) e-scooters (and Ninebot-built EUCs) use the same Nordic-UART serial-over-BLE bridge as the Xiaomi M365 — see xiaomi-m365-ble.yaml for the register read/write model and the ESC/BMS register map, which are shared. Only the outer frame differs.
GATT: Nordic UART service 6e400001-b5a3-f393-e0a9-e50e24dcca9e; write/RX 6e400002-...; notify/TX 6e400003-... (same as the M365).
FRAME: header 5A A5 (vs the Xiaomi 55 AA), then length, source addr, destination addr, command, argument, payload, and a 2-byte little-endian checksum. The read/write register model and the ESC-vs-battery address scheme match the Xiaomi variant.
CRYPTO: the reference library's Ninebot transport is checksum-only (no AES/CCM/nonce/ECDH). Newer G30 firmware is widely reported to add AES session encryption; that is not confirmed from a source used here and should be verified before relying on plaintext access on current units.
SAFETY: on plaintext/older units the same "commands unauthenticated over BLE" class of issue as the M365 applies (shared bus + app-only password).

openness.notes: No vendor documentation; the plaintext framing is reverse-engineered. Newer-firmware session crypto is not covered by the fetched sources.

credentials.notes: Older units gate the app only, not the bus. Newer firmware may add a session key — verify before assuming plaintext access. No Wi-Fi.
stored_on_device: Optional session key (newer firmware; unverified here)

factory_reset.effect: No documented BLE factory reset; settings are register writes. Not transcribed here.

methods.description: Connect to the NUS device, subscribe to 6e400003, and write 5A A5-framed register reads/writes to 6e400002 (register map per xiaomi-m365-ble).

steps.action: Connect and subscribe to the TX characteristic (6e400003).
Write a 5A A5-framed register read; parse the checksummed reply.

setup.notes: Connect over BLE, subscribe to the TX characteristic, and write 5A A5-framed register commands to RX (register model shared with the M365). On newer firmware a session-crypto handshake may be required — verify per unit.

rejoin.notes: No network membership; a new BLE client connects independently.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. The Nordic-UART bridge and the 5A A5 frame header are from Informatic/py9b (transport/ninebot.py); the shared register model from CamiAlfa/M365-BLE-PROTOCOL. Newer G30-class firmware is widely reported to add AES session crypto — NOT verified from a source here, so it is flagged, not asserted.
